title: Deciding signal from noise is part of perception itself

statements.text: Neural activity is always noisy, so the brain must decide whether activity reflects a reliable signal or baseline fluctuation. These decision mechanisms are part of the perceptual process, not a step after it, and prefrontal neurons that read out sensory signals contribute to the percept.

sources.quote: these decision mechanisms are integral to the perceptual process itself
it is unclear how early sensory activity on its own can lead to conscious percepts; decisional mechanisms are needed
